prompt: Write a police officer's crash report narrative (about 120 words). Collision type: rear-end collision in Pearland, Texas. The claimant was a driver and reported concussion. Refer to people as Driver 1, Driver 2 or Passenger. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1122; do not mention it.)
text: Officer narrative: On arrival at the scene in Pearland, Texas, I observed a rear-end collision involving two passenger vehicles in the eastbound lanes. Driver 2 stated that Driver 1's vehicle slowed abruptly in traffic and that Driver 2 was unable to stop in time, striking the rear of Driver 1's vehicle. Driver 1 stated that the vehicle was stopped and that they were struck from behind. Damage was visible to the rear bumper of Driver 1's vehicle and the front end of Driver 2's vehicle. A Passenger in Driver 1's vehicle was seated in the front passenger seat and reported neck pain. Driver 1 reported dizziness, a headache, and confusion following the impact and stated they believed they may have hit their head on the steering wheel. Driver 1 was evaluated by EMS at the scene and transported for further medical assessment. Both vehicles were drivable and were moved to the shoulder. No citations were issued at the time of this report pending further investigation.
